description: List people and companies the state board cited for unlicensed contracting, filtered by county and/or name. Use when the user has a name or company from a truck or flyer but no license number, or asks who was caught working unlicensed after a storm. Republished as filed; a citation is not a judgment. Defaults to roofing-typed citations; set all_trades=true for all construction trades.

all_trades.description: false (default) = roofing-typed citations only; true = all trades

county.description: e.g. Lee, Miami-Dade, Dade — normalized automatically

name: unlicensed_activity
